title: Deos alienos & conflatiles: unauthorized Jehovah-images still count as alien gods because God never willed that mode
source_text: XXXVI. Sed majori cum specie opponi potest quod Deus Jeroboamo per prophetam exprobrat, fecisti tibi Deos alienos & conflatiles, ut me ad iracundiam provocares. Verum si Jeroboam, ut supra ostensum, non alium Deum in vitulis colebat, quam Jehovam, quomodo dicuntur ei facti dii alieni? Respondetur, imagines istas, quamvis ad veri Dei cultum fabricatae fuerint, nihilominus jure optimo Deos alienos appellari, quia Deus eas non agnoverat, nec unquam voluerat eo modo coli; ac proinde cultus ille, qui imaginibus illis deferebatur, non erat cultus a Deo institutus, sed ab hominibus inventus, & Deo perinde ingratus ac si alienis numinibus exhibitus fuisset.
pass_a_gloss: But with greater appearance it can be opposed that God through the prophet reproaches Jeroboam, thou hast made for thyself alien and molten Gods, that thou mightest provoke me to anger. But if Jeroboam, as was shown above, cultivated in the calves no other God than Jehovah, how are alien gods said to have been made for him? It is answered, that those images, although they were fabricated for the cult of the true God, are nevertheless by best right called alien Gods, because God had not acknowledged them, nor had ever willed to be cultivated in that mode; and accordingly that cult which was paid to those images was not a cult instituted by God, but invented by men, and equally ungrateful to God as if it had been exhibited to alien divinities.
pass_b_english: Prophetic Deos alienos still fits relative Jehovah-calves: God never authorized that mode.
Human-invented image-cult of the true God is as offensive as foreign-god cult.

choices.why: Justifies calling unauthorized images alien gods.
